subject: Reignite: next steps after discovery / timing check
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Koenig <sarah@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps & POC checklist

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

• What we heard: LumaHealth wants a lightweight POC to validate inference latency and transcript-handling for appointment-reminder flows; success metric = sub-200ms 95th percentile and integration with your event webhook.
• Redwood commitment: sandbox access to a scoped model variant, a short checklist for infra/SSO items, and 1 hour of engineer pairing for initial integration.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll send the POC checklist and a one-pager (attached) — please share with your engineer/IT.
2) Can we target a kickoff pairing session the week of Nov 29? I’m listing two options below — feel free to propose alternatives.
3) If there are procurement or security hoops, please share any required forms and we’ll loop in our security team.

Kickoff slots (PST): Tue Nov 30 10:00–11:00 or Wed Dec 1 14:00–15:00 — I’ve tentatively penciled both.

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (POC steps + minimal infra), redwood-one-pager.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting your team into the sandbox.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sarah Koenig <sarah@lumahealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumahealth.com
Date: 2026-11-19T18:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps & POC checklist

Hi Ava — thank you for the clear recap. This looks good. A couple of things on our side: 

• We’re starting a scheduled security review next week and IT asked for a completed security questionnaire (I attached the one we use). Can your security team fill this (or point to an SOC2 / data handling doc)?
• Given the review, Nov 30 / Dec 1 kickoff looks tight for us. Can we aim for the week of Dec 13?
• Also: we’ll need an initial SSO integration spec (SAML) for internal sign-on during the POC.

I’ve attached the security questionnaire (luma_security_questionnaire.xlsx). I’ll bring procurement into the thread for any commercial paperwork, but we expect this to be a light engagement if the technical fit is good.

Best,
Sarah Koenig
Lead Product Manager, LumaHealth
sarah@lumahealth.com

On Thu, Nov 18, 2026 at 10:22 AM Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:...
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Koenig <sarah@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps & POC checklist (follow-up)

Hi Sarah — just following up on the questionnaire and SSO note. I wanted to check two quick things so we can plan resources: 

1) Is your security team able to accept our SOC2 link instead of filling every line item? If so I’ll send the link and a short cover note describing data scoping for the POC.
2) If Dec 13 is still the target for kickoff, can you confirm and we’ll lock a pairing slot (we’re holding limited engineer time in mid-Dec).

If it helps, Marcus (cc’d) can jump in to answer any security or SSO questions — he’s handled SAML set-ups for three other customers in the last quarter.

Attachments: (none)

Thanks — two-minute reply is perfect.

Best,
Ava

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Koenig <sarah@lumahealth.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:05:00Z
Subject: Quick priority check — Redwood x LumaHealth POC

Hi Sarah — Ben here (jumping in to help coordinate timelines). Wanted to do a quick priority check: we haven’t seen the completed questionnaire or a confirmed kickoff and I want to make sure we’re aligned on the next step. Options from our side: 

A) If the security review will be slow, we can provide a short-term hosted sandbox with IP/URL allowlist and limited data scoping (no user PII) so your product team can validate integration and latency without SSO.
B) If procurement/security need to lead, we’ll pause resources and rebook when you’re ready (we’ll keep the hubspot deal open but mark tentative).

Which direction suits you? If A, we can schedule a 30-min office hours slot this week to unblock your engineer quickly. If B, a quick note on expected timeline (e.g., early Jan) would help our resourcing planning.

No pressure — just want to avoid surprises on both sides. If easier, reply with one line: A or B + desired kickoff week.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
